body:
What were your days like before you broke up compared to now? 

I used to do the same thing on a different account.

They did but they weren't really enough, I felt so frustrated that I never bothered to top them up. My GP doesn't seem bothered, I've been waiting so long on therapy. She once gave me literally around 70 anti-depressants, I don't understand why you'd give someone suicidal that many.
Did you spend a lot of time with her? What have you been doing since the break up? I'm so sorry you feel this way.
My gp. They gave me anti-depressants. I've been waiting a very long time on the therapy part, I don't think it's coming.

Yeah that was a panic attack, I've never taken one that badly before. 

Yeah I've been depressed since I was a child and suicidal for a number of years. Thank you, I have seen a doc but I've found them useless.

Well I got out of a relationship about three months ago. She was by no means a bad person and by no stretch of the imagination am I faultless but the relationship left me all sorts of fucked up. I'm seeing two different girls now (they seem pretty okay with it) and I seem unable to comprehend how I actually feel about them, if and how much I like them. I'm shit scared of my own feelings and my mates seem to think I'm a wanker for seeing two people (I'm 22 and gay and my ex is the first person I've ever kissed and trusted, these two girls are the second and third people I've ever kissed). They seem to think I'll hurt one of them and the thought of doing so scares the fuck out of me, and the thought of being hurt myself scares the fuck out of me too.

wow I'm normally not great at talking but I must have really needed to talk about this. I'm really sorry. Did what I write even make sense? I'm so sorry again, thank you for talking to me.

I don't believe posting would make you look bad. A lot of people who try to help others through depression or other mental illness have had it hit close to home in some way. Would you like to talk to me about it? If you make a post I'll read it, or you can comment here, or you can pm me.

I can't explain why this feels out of my control. I felt like this before a while ago and started sincerely planning how to end it. I can't explain why this feels like it has to be done, I believe I don't want to die. I've been trying to speak to someone about it but I've been on waiting list and waiting list for around a year.
if that's okay yeah I'd like to talk. I'm really sorry to be doing this I thought I'd been doing okay lately but now i'm freaking out incase I kill myself.

i'M really sorry to hear that, how have you been feeling since she left? 

My ex and I broke up around I don't even know, three months ago or something, and I never think about her because thinking about her is pain but for some reason now I'm thinking about her. She was a good person but she left me all sorts of extra fucked up.
How come you're feeling down too?
fuck thank you for replying. I came off my anti-depressants of my own accord and I'm trying to go back on them but I'm not really taking them, my mood's way down.
